falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,700 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 79% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~4,800; this would confirm a lower low and structural breakdown rather than a bottoming pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent extreme fear above the August 2024 peak VIX of ~28 would signal a systemic repricing event, not a capitulation bottom; the blowoff score of 41 suggests controlled selling, and sustained VIX >35 would indicate panic exceeding the reference pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by >50bps)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion beyond August 2024 levels would signal imminent recession pricing that overrides the bottoming pattern; the current signal of HOLD assumes stabilization, and a -50bp+ inversion would confirm macro deterioration incompatible with a bottom formation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
